description: Search npm or PyPI to estimate how crowded a package category is before you claim that a market is empty, niche, or competitive. Use this when you have a category or search phrase such as 'edge orm' and want live result counts plus representative matches. Do not use it to compare exact known package names or to infer adoption from downloads; it reflects search results, not market share. Registry responses are cached for 5 minutes.

query.description: Short registry search phrase to evaluate, for example 'mcp memory server' or 'edge orm'.

registry.description: Registry to search. Use 'npm' for JavaScript ecosystems and 'pypi' for Python ecosystems.

name: estimate_market

topResults.description: Representative top search matches that help interpret the market count.

description.description: Short package summary from registry metadata.

name.description: Package name returned by the registry.

score.description: Registry relevance score when npm provides one.

version.description: Latest version string returned in the result payload.

totalResults.description: Total number of matching packages reported by the registry search.

title: Package Market Search
